title: Planned 2027 Litter
subtitle: Boaz of Covenant Working Dogs x Aurora vom Norden
paragraphs: 10/30/2026 -- Aurora's heat cycle started today so she will begin progesterone testing next week to determine insemination dates but most likely that will occur in the second week of November for early January, 2027 puppies sired by International Champion Boaz of Covenant Working Dogs AS/BCAT/BH-VT/CSAU/DE/DMX/FN/FD/HDJ/IGP1.  Boaz does have a recessive fawn allele so puppies from this litter can be brindle or fawn, also flashy or plain.
